caption: South Korea is checking students' GLASSES before its biggest exam of the year 👓🤖 AI smart glasses cheating is real. Should exams go back to pen & paper only? #news #southkorea #ai #suneung #smartglasses #exam #worldnews

scenes.text: This country is about to *inspect every student's glasses*
scenes.say: South Korea is about to check every student's glasses. Here's why.

scenes.text: The *Suneung* - the 8-hour exam that decides a student's whole future
scenes.say: Thursday is the Soo-nung, the eight hour exam that decides their whole future.

scenes.title: The problem? *AI smart glasses.* Already caught in 2026:
scenes.say: The problem? A.I. smart glasses. Cheaters already got caught this year, and one even got criminally charged.

scenes.title: So on exam day, *officials will check:*
scenes.say: So officials will check glasses, watches, even sleeves and buttons. Phones off and handed in.

scenes.title: Caught with a smart device?
scenes.say: Get caught? Score wiped. And you're banned next year.

scenes.text: In a mock test, radio-frequency scanners *couldn't spot the AI glasses.* Officials admit fully blocking it is *impossible.*
scenes.say: The twist? In a test run, scanners couldn't even detect the glasses.
